newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex set to win Sri Lanka diesel,jet fuel tender.
newsitem.headline: Caltex set to win Sri Lanka diesel,jet fuel tender.

text.p: Caltex Bahrain is poised to win Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to buy 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil and jet fuel for end-October delivery, a CPC source said on Thursday.
Caltex's diesel offer was $1.77 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, and jet fuel at $1.40 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The combination cargo is for delivery to Colombo between November 24 and 25, and to Trincomalee for a later date in November.
The tender, which closed on October 30, attracted eight offers. The tender seeks 160,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel and would be awarded this evening.

In its last tender, CPC bought from Shell 130,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel at $1.45 per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes and 70,000 barrels of jet fuel at $1.07 a barrel premium for mid-November delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
